user.title: Connect to your FiberGateway router
user.description: Connect to your FiberGateway for device presence and router control. Requires local Telnet access; credentials are transmitted without encryption.

names.title: Router options
names.description: Phone detection is optional; disable it to use device inventory and router control without matching phones. When enabled, a device counts as a phone if its name contains any keyword, ignoring case. Commas and newlines separate keywords; departure delay keeps presence on through brief disconnections.

error.invalid_auth: The router rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the router; check the address, port and Telnet access.
error.unsupported_response: The Wi-Fi association output is unsupported; a station output sample is needed.
error.invalid_input: Check the connection details and remove control characters from credentials.
error.cannot_read_names: Connected devices were read, but DHCP device names are unavailable.
error.invalid_names: Enter at least one keyword, separated by commas or newlines.

abort.already_configured: This router connection is already configured.
